description: Implementation of the PacingSender class for congestion control in QUIC protocol, managing packet pacing, burst tokens, and congestion events.

classes.name: PacingSender
classes.description: Handles packet pacing logic for congestion control, including burst tokens, pacing rate, and event handling.

methods.name: set_sender
methods.description: Sets the sender interface used for congestion control.

methods.name: OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Handles congestion events, resets burst tokens on loss.

methods.name: OnPacketSent
methods.description: Updates pacing state after a packet is sent, manages burst tokens and pacing delays.

methods.name: OnApplicationLimited
methods.description: Marks the sender as application-limited, affecting pacing.

methods.name: SetBurstTokens
methods.description: Sets the initial burst token count.

methods.name: TimeUntilSend
methods.description: Calculates the delay until the next packet can be sent based on pacing logic.

methods.name: PacingRate
methods.description: Returns the current pacing rate, limited by maximum if set.
